meta.title: Fix memory leak in ItemInputCharset
meta.body_summary: Prevent memory leak in ItemInputCharset::commitCharEdit by adding a missing delete[].

perf_labels.notes: One-line fix adding delete[] in commitCharEdit; merged within 25 minutes with no human review, only bot rate-limit comment and CI memory delta report.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1 changed line, this is a minimal, atomic fix by absolute volume. It fits a tiny, low-risk memory leak fix that merged quickly and successfully.

review_details.performance_claim: Prevent memory leak in ItemInputCharset::commitCharEdit by adding missing delete[].

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Trivial single-line memory leak fix requires no review or benchmarking; Agent produced a correct one-character change that merged without friction.

detection_detail.code_reading: No explicit detection method visible in dataset; maintainer accepted fix without review, possibly after visual inspection or pre-existing knowledge of the leak.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance data or repro steps; only a terse summary in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The PR commit directly fixes the leak; no further regression was introduced.

core_change_summary.description: In src/ItemInputCharset.h, added a missing delete[] to free the temporary char buffer allocated in commitCharEdit, preventing a memory leak.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only one file changed with one line added.
change_trajectory: Single commit added delete[] to commitCharEdit.
